description: The original adult human male peasant: fair tan skin, stern ordinary face, straight near-black shoulder-length hair combed back, near-black moustache and short full beard. Plain dark forest-green long tunic with round close neckline, loose elbow-length sleeves, small pale brass studs around the sleeve cuffs, straight rectangular cut tabs around the thigh-length hem. A narrow plain brown leather belt with small brass buckle; gray beige fitted trousers and low plain brown leather ankle shoes. Both hands empty and loosely clenched. Preserve the native slender proportions, long legs, restrained woven cloth and dark green tonal weight. No hat, cape, armor, jewelry, weapons or invented costume embellishments. Native cloth and hair/beard palette variants will be derived offline; preserve clear material boundaries.
